tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Overview for recruiters, hiring managers and founders: current role, location, what he's open to, how he works, headline stats and contact links. Start here.

tools.name: get_journey
tools.description: Work history (resume), newest first: role, company, dates and quantified highlights, plus the career story across India and the UAE.

tools.name: list_case_studies
tools.description: Case studies (production voice AI at Machani Robotics plus six shipped ventures), side projects and build notes, framed as product work: problem, decision, trade-offs, outcome, metrics. Fields that are absent are not documented; do not invent them.

tools.name: get_skills_with_evidence
tools.description: Every skill mapped to where it shipped and a proof point. Use to check requirements from a job description. A skill missing from this list has no evidence.

tools.name: evaluate_role_fit
tools.description: Call when the user shares a job description or asks whether Anto fits a role. Returns his complete record and a rubric for an honest, evidence-based fit assessment, including gaps.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: Returns Anto's booking link and a suggested agenda. Use when the user wants to talk to him, schedule an interview, or discuss a project.

tools.name: priority_intro
tools.description: Send Anto a priority message that lands in his inbox flagged PRIORITY, with a reply within 48 hours. Costs $0.01 USDC on Base, paid via x402. You are only charged if the message is delivered. Only call when the user explicitly asks to reach out and has approved the payment; use the user's real email
